name: tenets
tagline_zh: 装进仓库就多了一位严苛架构师：Result 类型、边界校验、行为测试、文档契约、工作区边界。
tagline_en: Install a strict architect for your repo: Result types, boundary schemas, behavior tests, doc contracts.
desc_en: Generic engineering ruleset for monorepos, bound to each ecosystem by a language profile (TypeScript ships): typed Result error handling with invariants and the airlock, boundary schemas, deep modules and bounded control flow, examples-first behavioral TDD, documentation contracts, workspace boundaries, decision framework, change delivery, data/state modeling, and serverless runtime discipline. Us
why_zh: 不是又一份风格指南，而是把 TypeScript 生态的工程纪律编译成可执行规则。
why_en: Not another style guide—it compiles TypeScript engineering discipline into executable rules tied to language features, forcing.
limit_zh: 只认 TypeScript 语言画像，其他生态（Python/Go 等）需自配 profile；规则是原则性约束。
limit_en: TypeScript profile only; other ecosystems need custom profiles. Rules are principled constraints—static checks, no auto-fix. Build/release pipelines.
title_en: Engineering tenets for TS monorepos, errors to deploy
